subject.title: [Feature]: Support direct video upload to LLM

question: Should OpenClaw add first-class native video content for chat LLM turns now, and what raw-video egress/storage policy should gate WebChat/Gateway provider delivery?
rationale: The remaining work is a cross-surface product and security decision, not a narrow bug fix: it changes user upload behavior, model capability routing, provider auth/transport payloads, and handling of original user video bytes.

options.title: Sponsor a generic native-video contract
options.body: Approve a narrow design and split implementation across UI/Gateway, LLM content types, provider transports, security policy, docs, and tests.

options.title: Keep video in media-understanding for now
options.body: Do not add direct chat upload yet; improve and document the existing tools.media.video and provider-specific understanding paths instead.

options.title: Defer direct video upload
options.body: Leave the feature open or close as not planned until provider contracts and security requirements are stronger.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a generic native-video contract
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow design and split implementation across UI/Gateway, LLM content types, provider transports, security policy, docs, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The current comments and recent routing context already frame this as a maintainer product/security boundary decision.
